You will play a key role in supporting modern workplace services, enabling smooth collaboration, and continuously improving the quality of IT support across the organization. incidents related to Windows, MacOS and mobile devices, peripherals, printers, and collaboration tools Install, configure, maintain, and support desktop and laptop computers, mobile devices, and related equipment Assist users with Microsoft 365 applications and services, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications Support device enrollment, compliance, and management activities using Microsoft Intune Perform provisioning, deployment, and replacement of end-user devices using Microsoft Autopilot and standard deployment processes Support meeting rooms, Office applications Familiarity with Azure Active Directory and user account administration Good understanding of printing services and print management solutions Experience with Windows device
